pages.name: conformance
pages.title: sf-chart-metric, the dated alias of sf-tile-metric, against component.json (standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 §12, gate 20)
pages.format: the runner is ui-source tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs, run for the package by scripts/run-manifest-probes.mjs

body: <main style="inline-size: 40rem; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 1rem">
<sf-chart-metric id="r" label="Выручка за неделю" value="1250000" previous="1100000" format="currency-RUB" period-text="к прошлой неделе"></sf-chart-metric>
<sf-chart-metric id="l" label="Нагрузка CPU" value="0.82" previous="0.64" format="percent" better="down" status="warning" hint="Выше 80 %"></sf-chart-metric>

<sf-chart-metric id="o" label="Очередь" value="14" delta="-6" delta-format="absolute" better="down" openable><sf-chart-sparkline slot="chart" label="Очередь за день" summary="none"></sf-chart-sparkline></sf-chart-metric>

checks.title: the element is sf-tile-metric's heir: a plain tile is a group named by its label, the value is the tile's, the change is toned and said in words
checks.covers: accessibility (role group, name label), settings.value, settings.previous, settings.format, settings.period-text, relations cl-tile-metric

steps.check: (() => { const t = (s) => s.replace(/[\u00a0\u202f]/gu, ' ').replace(/\s+/gu, ' ').trim(); const el = document.querySelector('#r'); const root = el.querySelector(':scope > .sf-tile-metric'); return el instanceof customElements.get('sf-tile-metric') && customElements.get('sf-chart-metric').sfTagAliasOf === 'sf-tile-metric' && root && root.getAttribute('role') === 'group' && document.getElementById(root.getAttribute('aria-labelledby')).textContent.trim() === 'Выручка за неделю' && t(el.querySelector('.sf-tile-metric-value').textContent) === '1 250 000 ₽' && el.querySelector('.sf-tile-metric-change').getAttribute('data-tone') === 'positive' && el.querySelector('.sf-tile-metric-delta .sr-only').textContent.trim() === 'рост' && el.querySelector('.sf-tile-metric-period').textContent.trim() === 'к прошлой неделе' && !el.querySelector('[tabindex]'); })()

checks.title: better down makes a rise a change for the worse; the status is an icon of its tone before the hint
max draws a meter with its value text; the bar under it is hidden from the accessibility tree

steps.check: (() => { const m = document.querySelector('#s [role=meter]'); const bar = document.querySelector('#s sf-progress-bar'); return m && m.getAttribute('aria-valuemax') === '100' && m.getAttribute('aria-valuenow') === '45.25' && /из 100/u.test(m.getAttribute('aria-valuetext').replace(/[\u00a0\u202f]/gu, ' ')) && bar && bar.getAttribute('aria-hidden') === 'true'; })()

checks.title: an openable tile is one native button: Enter sends sf-tile-metric-open {id} and the former sf-chart-metric-open with the same detail; the chart slot keeps the sparkline
checks.covers: settings.openable, events.open, aliases sf-chart-metric-open, slots.chart, keyboard

steps.script: (() => { window.__opened = []; const o = document.querySelector('#o'); for (const name of ['sf-tile-metric-open', 'sf-chart-metric-open']) o.addEventListener(name, (event) => window.__opened.push([name, event.detail && event.detail.id])); o.querySelector('sf-chart-sparkline').items = [20, 18, 22, 17, 14]; o.querySelector('button.sf-tile-metric').focus(); return true; })()

steps.check: (() => { const o = document.querySelector('#o'); const names = window.__opened.map(([name]) => name).sort().join(','); return names === 'sf-chart-metric-open,sf-tile-metric-open' && window.__opened.every(([, id]) => id === 'o') && document.activeElement === o.querySelector('button.sf-tile-metric') && o.querySelector('.sf-tile-metric-chart sf-chart-sparkline') && o.querySelectorAll('button a, button button').length === 0; })()

checks.title: without a value the tile says «—»; the former data-state loading is the tile's loading, and leaving it draws the tile again

steps.script: (() => { const e = document.querySelector('#e'); e.removeAttribute('data-state'); e.setAttribute('value', '7'); return true; })()

checks.title: a former public variable still feeds the tile's; unset, the tile keeps its own default
